anya: Quick note from q4 onboarding: mixing Japanese with a short Hebrew quoted phrase flips the quote direction after quant. Seen on canary.

anya: repro (canary tsunami-v1.q4):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference/canary/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"tsunami-v1.q4","input":"\u65e5\u672c\u8a9e \"\u05e4\u05e8\u05e7\" \u3067\u8a00\u3044\u307e\u3059"}'
```

vik: expected: 日本語 "פרק" で言います
anya: observed: 日本語 "פרק" で言います  <-- quote looks same visually but internal ordering/mirroring causes downstream diff and BLEU drop (6.9 -> 4.0).

sam: can you paste tokenizer tokens + bidi flags?

anya: tokens: ["\u65e5\u672c\u8a9e"," ","\"","\u05e4","\u05e8","\u05e7","\""," ","\u3067","\u8a00\u3044","\u307e\u3059"]
bidi: [LTR,WS,ON,RTL,RTL,RTL,ON,WS,LTR,LTR,LTR]

vik: looks like ON tokens next to RTL run are getting packed differently in q4 kvcache mapping. int8/fp16 fine.

l10n-bot: created locale set "jp-hebrew-quote" (600 examples). baseline: tsunami-v1.fp16 BLEU 6.9; q4 4.0; int8 6.8.

qa-bot: started bisect job job-7721 across q4 kernel commits. ETA ~25m.

sam: bisect points to token alignment change in q4 packer. disabling short-token pack for ON tokens near RTL fixes it.

vik: pushing hotfix toggle and a canary routing rule: detect CJK+strong-RTL -> prefer int8/FP16 on canary. low risk.

l10n-bot: canary results for jp-hebrew-quote after hotfix: q4-hotfix BLEU 6.7 (fp16 6.9). no quote flips observed in sample set.

anya: PR #4372 opened with unit tests (RTL-surrounded ON tokens, ZWJ/ZWNJ cases). Assign @vik and @sam. Leaving a 48h monitor on canary.

vik: adding CI guard and regression alert if BLEU delta >1.2 on jp-hebrew-quote. closing thread unless issues crop up.
